objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.0 — Interactive VR
objects.description: Original Marco Fugaro GPU noodle solver, adapted for Quest 3 native WebGPU passthrough. Pull individual strands with the trigger, move and resize the bundle with Zelda v13 grips. Eight strands by default, optional gravity; Quest testing pending.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.1 — Tabletop Physics
objects.description: Compact pile of GPU-simulated noodles on a visible wooden table. Always-on gravity, finite tabletop and leg collision geometry, trigger grabs and shared Zelda controls. Quest testing pending.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.2 — Two-Hand Interaction
objects.description: Independent two-controller noodle grabs in the same GPU collision simulation. Gravity unchanged; increased friction, damping and controlled separation for heavier-feeling, less slippery noodles. Tabletop and Zelda v13 grips retained.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Discobolus GPU V1.0 — Gold in VR
objects.description: Original opaque muted-blue immersive studio with GPU Gray–Scott gold relief. Owner confirmed both Balanced and Original Fine modes work on Quest 3 on 27 November 2026.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro (original demo and simulation)

hardwareVerification.scope: Original immersive VR experience, both mesh quality settings

objects.title: Discobolus GPU V1.1 — VR & Passthrough
objects.description: Original blue studio plus optional native WebGPU mixed reality. Both mesh qualities, marble/gold lighting, painting and Zelda controls preserved. New passthrough mode awaits Quest testing.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro (original demo and simulation)

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.0 — VR & Passthrough
objects.description: Owner-confirmed working independent native WebGPU light-driven metallic debris simulation with 8,000–150,000 fragments, dual controller beams, dark VR and mixed reality; shared Zelda v13 grips. Individual preset test coverage not specified.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.0 working successfully; specific device, environment and GPU presets were not stated in this feedback.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.1 — Spatial Audio
objects.description: Preserves V1.0 GPU simulation and presets; adds two spatial trigger lasers, quiet procedural ambient sound and sampled GPU fragment-contact crystal chimes. Independent audio volume controls; Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.1 looks pretty good; exact audio, device and preset coverage not stated.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.2 — Refractive Glass
objects.description: Solid distorted glass with native WGSL convex ray/plane refraction, internal reflections and experimental wavelength dispersion; three optics levels independent of density, original physics and spatial audio. Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.2 was beautiful; exact preset and device coverage not stated.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.3 — Spatial Rain
objects.description: V1.2 refractive glass unchanged; eight head-tracked spatial rainfall regions follow cloud position, scale and sampled GPU fragment motion, with higher-pitched dual trigger rain. Quest testing pending.
